notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the world of Cat Tree![/h1] 
In this demo, you’ll get a first taste of the relaxing and charming atmosphere, where a mysterious tree is home to a variety of adorable cats.

For now, this is just a [b]prototype showcasing[/b] the core game mechanics. 

[h2]You will be able to: [/h2]
[list]
[*] buy and sell cats, 
[*] discover unique coat patterns,
[*] meet cats with special traits. 
[*] unlock new spaces on your tree to house your feline companions. 
[/list]

We are eager to hear your feedback on the demo, as this is just the beginning of a long journey. We're planning to introduce a feature for [b]passive currency farming[/b], so that while you're away, your cats can gather some leaves for you. In the full version, we’ll add even more content, including additional cats, to ensure that everyone can find their perfect furry friend!

Thank you for your support and for being part of our project. There’s much more to come – this is just the start of your journey in the world of Cat Tree!
